card.title: Budget decision needed
card.label: Budget decision {{name}}

reason.used_up: The limit is used up: the next model request does not fit what is left.
reason.request_too_large: The next request can cost up to {{next}}, but only {{left}} are left. It was not sent; nothing was billed for it.

block.run: The limit of this run blocks.
block.subworkflow: The own limit of the sub-workflow “{{label}}” blocks.
block.team: The own limit of the team “{{label}}” blocks.
block.appliesExactly: A raise changes exactly this limit.

card.deadlinePassed: The deadline has passed; the run ends without a decision.
card.unbounded: its cost cannot be bounded in advance
card.unboundedHint: A higher limit does not make an unknown price known; such requests stay uncapped.
card.suggested: {{limit}}, the minimum for the next request. It is not a forecast of what the rest of the run will cost.
card.noSuggestion: none, because the cost of the next request cannot be bounded in advance.
card.newLimit: New total limit for this run (USD)
card.newLimitHint: The new total, not the amount to add. Higher than the current limit.
card.newLimitHintMax: The new total, not the amount to add. Higher than the current limit and at most {{max}}.

validation.invalid: Enter an amount in US dollars, for example 2.50.
validation.notHigher: The new limit must be higher than the current limit of {{current}}.
validation.overPolicy: The workspace allows at most {{max}} per run.

card.thisRunOnly: Applies to this run only; the workflow and the settings stay unchanged.
card.raisedToast: Limit raised to {{limit}}. The run continues.
card.cannotDecide: You may see this decision but not make it: the person who started the run or an administrator decides.
card.decidedElsewhere: This decision was already made elsewhere: {{outcome}}.

youDecided.raised: You raised the limit to {{limit}}. The run continues.

panel.waiting: The run waits for a budget decision. Nothing is sent to a model until someone decides.

approvals.title: Budget decisions
approvals.description: Runs that pause because their budget is not enough for the next model request.

chat.paused: The run waits for a budget decision. Questions are still answered (from the chat budget); instructions are used once the run continues. A chat message never approves budget.

settings.maxRunBudgetHint: No run may start with or be raised above this limit. Empty: no cap.
settings.decisionHoursHint: How long a run waits for a budget decision before it ends (1 to 720 hours).
settings.invalidMax: Enter an amount in US dollars or leave the field empty.
settings.operatorCap: At most {{max}} per run (the operator's cap).
